history.summary: The strongest entry in the batch: a very large 1,367 sqft 2BR at just $1,243 psf — a remarkable 31% below the $1,805 median — only 280m from Bright Hill MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line, becoming a Cross Island Line interchange by 2030). Backed by 7.0%/yr resale CAGR on 137 transactions, 756 units of liquidity, and documented 27.6% post-MRT-opening uplift. The deep PSF discount almost certainly reflects an oversized/old-stock layout, so verify the actual unit, but the value and catalyst stack is exceptional.
history.rating_rationale: Best top-1000 score in the batch (862) and the case is fundamentally sound: 280m to a TEL station that becomes a CRL interchange by 2030 (a top-tier future-infrastructure catalyst), 7.0%/yr resale CAGR on a healthy 137-txn sample, 756-unit liquidity, and a proven 27.6% price rise since Bright Hill opened in 2021. PSF of $1,243 vs $1,805 median is a 31% gap — partly an oversized 1,367 sqft 2BR (efficiency caveat) but still deep value with a generous absolute size. Schools (Ai Tong, Catholic High) and Bishan Park add own-stay resale demand. Only minor concerns (parking, lease from 1997). Clears the Strong Buy bar.
red_flags: 1,367 sqft for a 2BR is oversized — verify it is not an awkward/dual-key layout; PSF discount partly reflects this
99-yr lease from 1997, ~70 years remaining — monitor over a longer hold
catalysts: 280m to Bright Hill MRT — TEL now, Cross Island Line interchange by ~2030 (strongest infra catalyst in batch)
27.6% resale uplift already realized since Bright Hill opened in 2021, with CRL re-rating still ahead
Top-tier school catchment (Ai Tong, Catholic High) and Bishan/Thomson amenity deepen resale demand
756-unit development — high liquidity and broad buyer base

history.summary: A 22-year-old 1,152 sqft 3BR in Bishan/Sin Ming, 280m from Bright Hill TEL station, asking $1,866 PSF — a ~3% premium to the $1,806 median. The standout 7.0% URA resale CAGR (137 txns) and a near-MRT TEL location are genuinely attractive, but only ~73 years of lease remain and that decay over a 5-7yr hold is the key drag, leaving a balanced Neutral-to-Buy that lands at Neutral on the lease math.
history.rating_rationale: The appreciation case is the best in the batch — 7.0% URA resale-only CAGR over 137 transactions — and a 280m walk to Bright Hill TEL station in a strong Bishan/AMK school catchment is a real plus. But the offsets are material: built 2004 with only ~73 years lease remaining, so lease decay accelerates and the finance/buyer window narrows precisely over an investment hold; asking $1,866 PSF is already a premium to the $1,805 median (paying up for an old leasehold); score 594 / MMR 1519 is the lowest in the batch and below frontier; and there are visitor-parking shortfalls flagged by residents. The strong past CAGR partly reflects the new TEL station opening — that one-time re-rating may already be largely captured.
red_flags: ~73 years lease remaining (2004 build) — lease decay accelerates over the hold; tighter financing for future buyers
